# netbox_fhrp_group_assignments (Data Source)

Lists fhrp_group_assignment objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_fhrp_group_assignments" "test" {
  limit = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Query filters, sent as API list parameters. Supported names: group_id, group_id__n, id, id__empty, id__gt, id__gte, id__lt, id__lte, id__n, interface_id, interface_id__n, interface_type, interface_type__n, priority, priority__empty, priority__gt, priority__gte, priority__lt, priority__lte, priority__n. Repeating a name sends that parameter once per value. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of objects to return from the API lookup. Defaults to 1000.

### Read-Only

- `fhrp_group_assignments` (Attributes List) The matching fhrp_group_assignments. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fhrp_group_assignments))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the query filter (the API list parameter).
- `value` (String) Value to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--fhrp_group_assignments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fhrp_group_assignments`

Read-Only:

- `created` (String)
- `group_id` (Number) Id of the FHRP group.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `interface_id` (Number) Id of the interface named by interface_type.
- `interface_type` (String) Type of the interface the group is assigned to, e.g. dcim.interface or virtualization.vminterface.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `priority` (Number) Priority of this interface within the group (0-255).
- `url` (String)
